name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px inner #fff at 80% opacity. This meets WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 contrast requirement for interactive elements while remaining visible on all backgrounds. The thicker ring improves touch target visibility on mobile, where smaller rings can disappear. Trade-off: the 3px ring uses slightly more screen space than the 2px version, but the accessibility gain outweighs the minimal layout impact.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring risks blurring into adjacent interactive elements on high-contrast backgrounds, making it harder to distinguish the active element. A 2px ring with a 2px inner #fff at 90% opacity meets WCAG 2.2’s 4.5:1 contrast requirement while keeping targets clear on light surfaces. Test both against the EXCAVA UI in grayscale and high-contrast modes to confirm.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px inner #fff at 90% opacity. It meets WCAG 2.2’s 4.5:1 contrast requirement for interactive elements, ensuring clarity on all backgrounds. The thinner ring reduces blur risk between adjacent targets while remaining visible on mobile. Trade-off: it’s slightly less prominent than the 3px version, but the improved clarity outweighs the marginal visibility loss.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring still poses a risk on very light surfaces where the 4.5:1 contrast may not be enough, potentially failing to provide sufficient visibility for users with visual impairments. A better alternative could be a dynamic focus ring that adjusts its size and color based on the background, ensuring optimal contrast and clarity in all scenarios. To settle the argument, we need to conduct thorough usability testing with diverse user groups to determine the most effective and inclusive focus ring design.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt the 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with 2px inner #fff at 90% opacity for EXCAVA, with dynamic adjustment to 3px ring on light surfaces. Owner: Ramp.
